title: Aye Mere Nana Deene Khuda Ko Bacha Ke Aayi Hun
body:
Aye mere nana dine khuda ko bacha ke aayi hun
Bala ke ban me kamayi maa'n ki luta ke aayi hun
Nana kaho to haal sunaye tmko ye dukhiya
Dashte bala me lasha pada tha god ke paalon ka
Gham bhi manane diya gaya na maaon ko wa waila
Zulm ki had ye ho gayi nana rone pe tha pahra
Charo taraf the zulm ke bani koi na tha apna
Ghar ko luta or jangal ko basa ke aayi hun
Ibne hasan pamal hua tha zinda maqtal me
Or kaleja akbar ka tha barchhi ke phal me
Asghar ka khu'n ab bhi laga hai maa'n ke anchal me
Zulm hua hai nana ham par aisa jangal me
Suraj ne bhi ankh chhupa li apni badal me
Nana kitne sadme dil par utha ke aayi hun
In aankhon se kya kya manzar dekha zainab ne
Khun me duba bhai ka paikar dekha zainab ne
Khushk gale pr shimr ka khanjar dekha zainab ne
Bhai ko pamali ki zad par dekha zainab ne
Noke sina par bhai ka sar dekha zainab ne
Kaise manazir in aankhon me chhipa ke aayi hun
11 muharram ko aye nana aesi qayamat thi
Zulm ke bani charo taraf the or na tha koi
Bhai tha be goro kafan or ahle haram qaidi
Kaise bataun nana jo thi halat abid ki
Hanth me rasha aankh me aansu chehre par zardi
Maut ke panje se main usko chhurda ke aayi hun
Bhuli nahi mqin karbobala ke dardo alam ab bhi
Aankhon me mahfuz hai mere shaame gham ab bhi
Nana mere zakhmi hain abid ke qadam ab bhi
Tauq gira'n ke sabab se uski pusht hai kham ab bhi
Sath liye hun sare nishan e zulm o sitam abhi
Kya kahun nana kitne durre kha ke aayi hun
Qabre payambar kanp uthi zainab ki sadaon se
Aane lagi thi giriye ki awaz fizaon se
rauza nabi ka gunj utha fariyad se aanhon se
Ashk gire be sakhta har bibi ki nigahon se
Jab ye kaha zainab ne aye nana teri duaon se
Bhai ka chehlum karbobala me mana ke aayi hun
Ek bala ka hashr bapa tha rauze pr asghar
Koi sina pit raha tha koi apna sar
Rote the sab bain ali ki beti ke sun kar
Kaise bataun dagh liye hain kitne sine par
Zainab to aayi hai nana sath nahi sarwar
Sar jab sabke mile hain to dafna ke aayi hun
